headings.usage: All section titles, card headers, and large numeric values.

monospace.usage: Transaction IDs, Proof IDs, Hashes, Ed25519 signatures, Timestamps (UTC).

body.usage: Dense UI labels, descriptions, list items, and standard copy.

layout_grid.sidebar: w-[240px] flex-shrink-0 border-r border-slate-200 bg-white flex flex-col h-full
layout_grid.topBar: h-14 flex-shrink-0 border-b border-slate-200 bg-white flex items-center px-6 justify-between
layout_grid.rightRail: w-[320px] flex-shrink-0 border-l border-slate-200 bg-white p-6 overflow-y-auto flex flex-col gap-6 hidden lg:flex
layout_grid.verifyProofLayout: grid grid-cols-1 xl:grid-cols-3 gap-6 items-start w-full

sidebarNav.active: flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-2 rounded-md text-sm bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 font-semibold border-l-2 border-blue-600
sidebarNav.inactive: flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-2 rounded-md text-sm text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100 hover:text-slate-900 transition-colors border-l-2 border-transparent
sidebarNav.groupLabel: px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 mt-4

cards.container: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-lg shadow-sm overflow-hidden
cards.header: flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-100 px-4 py-3 bg-slate-50/50

badges.pass: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[11px] font-semibold bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border border-emerald-200 uppercase tracking-wider
badges.fail: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[11px] font-semibold bg-red-50 text-red-700 border border-red-200 uppercase tracking-wider
badges.neutral: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[11px] font-semibold bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 border border-slate-200 uppercase tracking-wider

dataDensity.row: flex justify-between items-center py-1.5 border-b border-slate-100 last:border-0
dataDensity.value: text-xs font-semibold text-slate-900 text-right max-w-[60%] truncate

Demo_View.Center_Main: Render the 'Transaction Form' and 'Compliance Checks' stacked densely. Transaction form inputs inline. Simulated failure toggle floated right on the Compliance list header. Evidence Generation block spans full width, using dark code-block aesthetics (bg-slate-900 text-slate-50) for the Ed25519 hash to pop out visually and convey cryptographic gravity.
Demo_View.Right_Rail: Render 'Proof Summary' card at top (State: Awaiting/Verified, Checks Passed, Status), followed by 'Next Steps' (Verify/Share), and 'Recent Proofs' (Local storage list showing Time, Amount, Verified Badge).

Verify_Proof_View.Header: Full width spanning top of main content area. Large Space Grotesk title with Verified badge. Row of key-value items (Industry, Txn ID, Issued At, Proof ID) compactly arranged.
Verify_Proof_View.Three_Column_Grid: Place 'Compliance Checks', 'AI Accountability', and 'Cross-Party Consistency' side-by-side using `grid-cols-3`. Each card must have aggressive data density (py-1.5 padding on rows, text-xs) to prevent vertical scrolling. The UI must fit completely in one viewport on a 13-15 inch screen at 100% zoom. Cross-Party Consistency should graphically represent Party A vs Party B side-by-side within its column.

states.empty: For 'Recent Proofs': A compact rounded box with dashed slate-300 borders, a subtle icon, and 'No session proofs' in slate-400. Very subtle, no massive empty-state illustrations.
states.loading: Use shadcn/ui Skeletons with exact height match of the final content to prevent layout shifts. Rapid shimmer effect.

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid: MANDATORY. Every button, toggle, and key data value must have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case. e.g., 'simulate-failure-toggle', 'verify-proof-button', 'compliance-pass-badge'.
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Text over backgrounds must meet APCA standards. Slate-500 on Slate-50 requires at least font-medium for legibility.

instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT introduce fictional metrics (Risk Score, Trust Score, etc.). Only map the REAL data defined in the problem statement.
DO NOT use a user profile chip or avatar. This is a public demo.
Replace existing top tabs with the Sidebar defined in layout_grid. App Shell should manage global state routing between the views.
Recent Proofs must be hooked up to localStorage so it works during a single session, populating the Right Rail.
The 3-column verify layout is non-negotiable for desktop. Keep padding minimal inside cards (`p-3` or `p-4`) so it all fits on one screen without scrolling.
If using icons, default to 'lucide-react' standard icons. Keep them small (size 14-16) to match the dense typography.
The 'Simulate Compliance Failure' toggle must break the proof state gracefully in the UI without altering underlying cryptographic business logic.
